verdict: Yes, for founders who trek themselves. Tripole Gear pitched trekking gear and backpacks on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal, with strong revenue. Trekking has grown fast among young Indians, but Decathlon is the default choice, so you need gear designed for Himalayan treks and Indian budgets.
angle: Treks in Uttarakhand, Himachal and Sikkim fill up every season, and trekkers need backpacks, jackets and poles. Trek organisers and guides influence what first-timers buy. Rental and resale can add income during slow months.
